acceptanceCriteria: A change under `docs/` selects the packages whose tests read the changed files, with the rule named in the plan.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #74 (V1-0002): `corvint affected` returned EMPTY_SELECTION for a docs-only change while at least eight packages read docs in tests.

completion.reason: Completed 2026-09-24 by PR #137 (merge 6a388a298). Criterion 1: corvint affected selects every Go package whose string literals name a changed path, including docs, with the witness PATH_LITERAL_READER named in the plan (internal/liveverify/affected/select.go:17, readers.go:18; AFP-V0-021, docs/specs/affected-plan-v0.md:363, trace :439). A one-line append to docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md now selects 26 packages instead of EMPTY_SELECTION, including all 8 that the gate's -bounds mode names (docs/BUILD-LOG.md:219-240). Tests include TestAffectedDocumentSelectsThePackageThatNamesIt and TestPathLiteralSelectsItsReaderPackage_AFPV0021; the affected packages pass at 6d4873a. Caveats: scope stays UNKNOWN because the gate's rule (d) for unbounded readers is not modelled, and the CEM sidecar narrowing is not mirrored, which adds noise. Graph build CPU rose from ~2.3 s to ~4.3 s. Owner-only: AFP-V0-021 is proposed in an accepted spec, and whether a named path may become BOUNDED is open. Sealed at .corvint/changes/83ad8c3deeba32afb1a3f3c9cb8f81667e5afc56.cem.json. Evidence digests: sha256 at 6d4873a of the sealed CEM, readers.go, select.go, affected-plan-v0.md. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner focused-verification policy).

title: affected: docs-only changes select no packages although eight packages read docs
